        <div class="row justify-content-between align-items-center">
            <div class="col-12 col-md-6 ms-xl-5 ms-lg-4 ps-lg-4" style="">
                <h2 class="fs-0">About us</h2>
                <h2 class="font-poppins font2-color fs-2 col-11 col-lg-9 fw-normal mb-4 pb-3">Kitesurfing Lanka – A home for kitesurfer, wing foiler &amp; free spirits</h2>
                <div class="pb-4 font2-color">
                    <p><span style="font-weight: 400">Founded in 2010 by Dilsiri Welikala – Sri Lanka’s first local instructor – and Léo Moret, Kitesurfing Lanka was born from a shared dream. What started as one of the first kite camps in Kalpitiya has evolved into a thriving resort for water sports lovers worldwide. (Tap “Our Story” to dive deeper into our journey.)</span></p>
<p>Set on 8 acres of beachfront, our camp offers direct access to both the Kalpitiya lagoon&#8217;s flat water and the ocean waves beyond the sandbank. It’s a welcoming place for all levels—whether you’re here to master your first meters with our Kiteschool Sri Lanka instructors or to push your limits in the open sea.</p>
<p data-path-to-node="11,0">As one of the most established destinations for kitesurfing in Sri Lanka, we provide everything you need for the perfect ride. From professional kitesurfing lessons Kalpitiya to high-end kite rental Sri Lanka services and wingfoil Kalpitiya coaching, we’ve got you covered.</p>
<p data-path-to-node="11,1">Between sessions, enjoy our lush gardens, the chillout bar, or our seaside restaurant.</p>
<p data-path-to-node="11,1">At KSL, you’re not just booking a room; you’re joining a vibrant community.</p>

            <h2 class="fs-2 font2-color font-poppins mb-4 pb-3 fw-normal">Kitesurfing &amp; wing foiling adventures in Sri Lanka</h2>
            <div class="mb-4 font2-color pb-3"><p data-path-to-node="7">Located on the Kalpitiya Peninsula, Kitesurfing Lanka is your gateway to one of Asia’s most versatile watersports destinations. Our unique location offers direct access to a protected lagoon with butter-flat water and gentle ocean waves just beyond the sandbank.</p>
<p data-path-to-node="8">This rare combination creates beginner-friendly conditions ideal for learning, while providing the perfect playground for advanced progression. Whether you are here for kitesurfing, wing foiling, or wakeboarding, our Kiteschool Sri Lanka provides expert instruction and professional kite rental Sri Lanka services to get you on the water with the best equipment.</p>
</div>
            <a href="https://www.kitesurfinglanka.com/kitesurfing-trips-kitesurfing-spots/" class="btn font-poppins font1-color btn-outline-primary  lh-1 ps-4 rounded-3 pe-2 "

<section class="" style=" ">
<div class="mx-auto bg-white rounded-4 pb-5" style="max-width: 1300px;">
        <!-- seasons -->
    <div class="container-fluid pt-3 pt-lg-2 pb-5">
        <div class="container ms-0 ms-md-auto mt-3 my-lg-3">
            <div class="row justify-content-between">
                <div class="col col-md-6 col-xl d-flex flex-column align-items-start">
                     <h2 class="fs-0">Seasons</h2> 
                    <h3 class="font-poppins font2-color fs-2 mb-4 pb-3 mb-lg-auto col-lg-6 fw-normal">Two distinct windy seasons</h3>
                    <a href="https://www.kitesurfinglanka.com/live-wind-report/" class="btn font-poppins font1-color btn-outline-primary  lh-1 ps-4 rounded-3 pe-2 "
    style="min-width: 207px; background-color:#f2b61a; " aria-label="Read More">
    <div class="d-flex align-items-center font2-color justify-content-between" style="">
        Live Wind        <span class="ms-4 font2-color">
            <svg></svg>
        </span>
    </div>
</a>                </div>
                <div class="col-12 col-md-6 col-xl-auto mt-4 font2-color" style="max-width: 510px;"><p data-path-to-node="13">Kalpitiya offers two reliable kite seasons in Kalpitiya, making it a world-class destination throughout most of the year.</p>
<ul data-path-to-node="14">
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="14,0,0"><b data-path-to-node="14,0,0" data-index-in-node="0">Summer Season (mid-May – mid-October):</b> Expect strong, consistent cross-shore wind averaging 18–25 knots, with peaks up to 30 knots. It’s the peak time for non-stop action from dawn till dusk.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="14,1,0"><b data-path-to-node="14,1,0" data-index-in-node="0">Winter Season (mid-December – mid-March):</b> Offers lighter, steady afternoon winds ranging from 15–25 knots. Mornings are perfect for yoga, diving, or dolphin and whale watching.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p data-path-to-node="15">Both seasons are warm and dry with water temperatures around 27°C, meaning you can kite without a wetsuit all year. While the wind direction shifts between seasons, the adventure remains the same: reliable wind, warm water, and a variety of spots to explore for every beginner or advanced kitesurfer.</p>
</div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="d-flex d-xl-block mx-3 mx-xl-0 pt-4 " >
        <!-- winter season -->
